ITEM 1 | Dark green, finely chopped leafy greens with ruffled edges and some torn pieces, mostly matte with slight moisture sheen, clustered in an irregular mound on the lower-right of the plate, covering roughly 25% of the plate's area and about 2 cm high at the thickest point; pale green stem pieces and a few light, translucent flakes are scattered within, and the mound sits on the bare white plate surface | 90

ITEM 2 | Pale yellowish-white, thin translucent flaky pieces with slightly curled edges, mixed among the greens near the center of the mound, roughly 1 to 2 cm across, dry-looking with a faint sheen, sitting on top of and between the dark green leaves | 8
